messages:
thompson_cust: Hey team, starting ~18:20 UTC last night we saw a burst of 429s from your API. Traffic steady overall but spikes every 60s-ish. Example: 429 for requests that used to succeed. Request id: req_0a3f. Can you triage?

sam_support: Sorry about that — can you paste a curl + timestamp and your org id? Is this across regions or just us-east?

thompson_cust: Org: acme-ops-57. Mostly us-east-1. Here's a quick curl we recorded at 2026-03-15T18:21:03Z:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/respond -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: req_0a3f
x-rw-rpm-limit: 1200
x-rw-rpm-used: 1200
x-rw-tpm-limit: 20000
x-rw-tpm-used: 19980
```

mia: Thanks. That header set is super helpful. Shows you're hitting the per-minute RPM cap at exactly the window boundary. Do you have any scheduled jobs that run on minute-aligned boundaries?

thompson_cust: We run dozens of tiny cron-style workers across many machines — they poll every minute to sync state. They jittered before but a recent deploy removed the random jitter (oops).

alex_sre: That matches a classic distributed-sync microburst: many clients firing near the same second, filling the minute token bucket. Two quick mitigations: 1) re-enable client-side jitter/stagger; 2) temporary quota bump / server-side smoothing while you roll out fix.

jordan_engineer: On our side we can enable short-term burst smoothing for their API key — it redistributes token consumption across a rolling 60s window instead of strict per-minute buckets. If we do +50% RPM it should stop the immediate 429s. Want me to schedule that?

sam_support: Please escalate — opening infra ticket JIRA-6789 and flagging for quota review. Jordan, go ahead with smoothing toggle and +50% RPM until Friday EOD. I'll notify the customer.

alex_sre: Also advise client-side exponential backoff with full jitter. Example pseudo: 
```
retry_delay = min(base * 2^attempt, max)
delay = random(0, retry_delay)
```
Even 200-500ms randomization across workers flattens spikes.

thompson_cust: Appreciate it. We'll re-add jitter and push a patch in the next hour. Please let me know when you flip smoothing.

deploy-bot: user/jordan_engineer requested config change: toggle burst_smoothing=true for api_key=acct-acme-57 — change queued, deploy in 2m.

jordan_engineer: Done — smoothing turned on and RPM increased from 1200 -> 1800 for acct-acme-57. Monitor dashboards for the next 15m.

mia: Seeing their RPM usage flatten on dashboards, 429 count dropped to 0 in the last 2 windows. We'll keep this config until you confirm client patch.

thompson_cust: Patch deployed with jitter back in. Running tests now — 429s gone from our side. Thanks all.

sam_support: Follow-ups: (1) keep smoothing until Friday EOD unless you need longer, (2) we'll schedule a postmortem with rate-limiter team to discuss longer-term options (adaptive quotas, per-route rate shaping), (3) we logged action JIRA-6789.

jordan_engineer: Adding recommendation doc link: https://internal.redwood.ai/rate-limits/best-practices — includes client jitter examples and guidance for cron alignment.

thompson_cust: Sounds good. Please share the JIRA when ready and we'll confirm when to remove the temporary bump. Thanks again. :thumbsup:
